examples.label: Pull quote with its source attributed underneath
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" class="max-w-xl">
  A page is finished when there is nothing left to explain to the person using it.
  <:caption>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-cite" site="Global" size="small" class="pr-3">The Mishka CMS editor handbook, chapter 4</.component>
  </:caption>
</.component>

examples.label: Footnote crediting the source of a figure
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="opacity-70">
  Adoption figures come from <.component component_name="chelekom-cite" site="Global" size="small">our 2025 editor survey</.component>, answered by 1,140 sites.
</.component>
